senses.gloss:
n. (-यं)
A sort of perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla.
E.
स्थूणा an image, ढक् aff.; also with कन् added, स्थौणेयक.

n. (-रं)
1 Strength, power.
2 A load for a horse or ass, &c.
E.
स्थूल large, bulky, अण् aff., and ल changed to र.

m. (-री)
1 A pack-horse, one that carries burthens on his back like an ox or ass.
2 A strong horse.
E.
स्थौर strength, इनि aff., or according to some authorities स्थुरा a pack-saddle, इनि aff., deriv. irr.; it is also read स्थूरिन्, स्थुरिन्, and स्थोरिन्.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
Large-headed, having or relating to a large head or summit.
E.
स्थूल large, शिरस् the head, अण् aff.

n. (-ल्यं)
Bulk, size, coarseness, largeness.
E.
स्थूल, and ष्यञ् aff.
